changelog.change: Initial shape: the line in force, its four cells, and what it was made of.
changelog.why: Nothing recorded how the line the pipeline applies stands against the labels.

description: One run's reading of the applied merge line against the hand-marked holdout.

apart_and_one_story.description: The line left one story in two pieces. The reader sees it twice and can dismiss the second, which is why this is the cheaper of the two mistakes.
apart_and_one_story.title: Apart And One Story

apart_and_two_stories.description: The line left the pair apart and the label agrees they are two.
apart_and_two_stories.title: Apart And Two Stories

applied_line.description: The merge line in force when these cells were counted. On the row because two rows counted under two lines answer two different questions.
applied_line.title: Applied Line

cosine_weight.description: What the cosine was worth in the score the line was applied to. On the row because a later reader comparing two runs has to know both were asked the same question.
cosine_weight.title: Cosine Weight

date.description: The day the line was scored.
date.title: Date

key_point_weight.description: What the key-point term was worth. Same reason as the cosine weight.
key_point_weight.title: Key Point Weight

labelled_two_story_pairs.description: How many labelled pairs are marked two stories - the population the false-merge cell is drawn from. On the row so that no rate is ever read without the denominator it came from.
labelled_two_story_pairs.title: Labelled Two Story Pairs

labeller.description: Who marked the holdout. Free text rather than a model this repository ships, because the committed labels name a model from outside the registry and a narrower column would have to refuse the truth.
labeller.title: Labeller

merged_and_one_story.description: The line joined the pair and the label agrees it is one story.
merged_and_one_story.title: Merged And One Story

merged_and_two_stories.description: The line joined two stories that the label says are not one. The invisible direction: the reader never learns the second story existed.
merged_and_two_stories.title: Merged And Two Stories

pairs_unresolved.description: Labelled pairs neither cell could be counted for, because retention has deleted one of the two days they name. Reported rather than dropped, so a shrinking comparison is visible instead of silent.
pairs_unresolved.title: Pairs Unresolved

scorer_model.description: Which encoder produced the cosines these cells were counted under.
scorer_model.title: Scorer Model

title: MergeLineHoldoutScore
